verdict.rationale: Plausible is a privacy-focused web analytics service: a data source with dashboards, a Stats API and an Events API, not an AI agent or assistant host that would act as an MCP client. Nothing in the pack shows any built-in AI agent that could consume external MCP tools. Plugging MCP servers in to use their tools is therefore outside this product's role.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
